build.beforeDevCommand: bash -lc 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$ROOT"; if command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then corepack pnpm exec vite build --watch; elif [ -x "$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm" ]; then "$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm" exec vite build --watch; else pnpm exec vite build --watch; fi'
build.beforeBuildCommand: bash -lc 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$ROOT"; if command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1; then corepack pnpm exec vite build; elif [ -x "$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm" ]; then "$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm" exec vite build; else pnpm exec vite build; fi'
